mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_posts ( VIEW_COUNT, ATTACH_FILE, TITLE, RECRUIT_COUNT, EMPLOYMENT_TYPE, SALARY, WORK_TIME, CAREER, EDUCATION, TECH_STACK, APPLICATION_PERIOD, POSTS_CREATED_AT, COMPANY_IDX ) VALUES ( 0, #{attachFile}, #{title}, #{recruitCount}, #{employmentType}, #{salary}, #{workTime}, #{career}, #{education}, #{techStack}, #{applicationPeriod}, NOW(), #{companyIdx} );
mapper.select: SELECT JOB_POSTS_IDX, ATTACH_FILE, TITLE, RECRUIT_COUNT, EMPLOYMENT_TYPE, SALARY, WORK_TIME, CAREER, EDUCATION, TECH_STACK, APPLICATION_PERIOD, POSTS_CREATED_AT, COMPANY_IDX FROM job_posts WHERE JOB_POSTS_IDX = #{jobPostsIdx} AND COMPANY_IDX = #{companyIdx} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE job_posts SET TITLE = #{title}, ATTACH_FILE = #{attachFile}, RECRUIT_COUNT = #{recruitCount}, EMPLOYMENT_TYPE = #{employmentType}, SALARY = #{salary}, WORK_TIME = #{workTime}, CAREER = #{career}, EDUCATION = #{education}, TECH_STACK = #{techStack}, APPLICATION_PERIOD = #{applicationPeriod} WHERE JOB_POSTS_IDX = #{jobPostsIdx} AND COMPANY_IDX = #{companyIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX AS jobPostsIdx, jp.TITLE AS title, jp.POSTS_CREATED_AT AS postsCreatedAt, jp.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, jp.COMPANY_IDX AS companyIdx, cu.COMPANY_NAME AS companyName FROM job_posts jp JOIN company_users cu ON cu.COMPANY_IDX = jp.COMPANY_IDX WHERE jp.COMPANY_IDX = #{value} ORDER BY jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX DESC
